scope: Local release evidence only. Twenty real public documents plus three upstream decoder fixtures and seven synthetic controls. No private documents; no fixture bytes in the deployed site.
expectedTokenSemantics: Unicode NFKC, case-insensitive, whitespace-insensitive substring smoke checks. These do not certify reading order, table associations, equation fidelity, or complete usefulness.
coverageGaps: Browser print-to-PDF with verified browser provenance
Known printer hardware scans and mobile scanning-app exports
Real rotated, password, and broken-font examples (synthetic or partial cases only)
RTL embedded text and vertical writing
Hostile/malformed PDF matrix beyond signature/file-size/OCR-cap controls
Physical-device memory pressure and real Safari/Edge release support
Human review of output usefulness on every selected page
